_comment: Per-strategy capital multiplier (auto-allocator Layer 4 MVP). compute_risk_usd() multiplies the tier risk_pct by the strategy's factor. Default 1.0 for unlisted strategies. Decision Engine ACTION recommendations: SCALE_UP=1.5x, HOLD=1.0x, REDUCE=0.5x, KILL=0.0x, IGNORE=1.0x. Manual write OR via POST /api/allocation_factors {strategy, factor} - operator review required per project_capital_allocator_policy.md ('Manual approval until 90 days real evidence'). Clamped to 0.0-2.0 in code.

2026-05-19: forge_vix_carry -> 0.0 (RESEARCH_ONLY birth-state). Strategy built today per Architect audit 2026-05-19 as the top-ranked new-edge candidate (VIX term-structure contango harvest via SVXY long, gated on VIX<20 + contango>=1.05 + SPY realized vol<15%). 5-year backtest 2021-2026 returned -13.82% total / -3.07% CAGR / 33.1% max DD / PF=1.01 / win-rate 27% across baseline + 5 parameter variants. None of {tighter entry 1.10/1.15, looser exit VIX>=30, looser exit contango<0.95} produced positive return. n=10-15 trades is statistically uninterpretable but the evidence does not support promotion. Code retained as research scaffold + template for the next edge candidate; allocation locked at 0.0 until pre-2018 backtest or alternative validation. See forge/vix_carry/__init__.py STATUS block.

2026-05-19: forge_pead -> 0.0 through 5/31 reset (PAPER_CANDIDATE post-reset). Built today as Architect audit #2 (Post-Earnings Drift on Apollo's pre-vetted 16-name PEAD universe). 5-year backtest: n=69 trades, WR=37.7%, PF=2.04, avg_win +17.3%/avg_loss -5.1%, scaled equity growth (15% position) +38.5% / +7.47% CAGR / 11.5% max DD. Per-ticker spread healthy (11/16 names contributed >=3 trades; top: PLTR/REGN/MU/GOOGL/TSM). Exits 61% atr_stop, 39% hold_period_end. HONEST CAVEAT: Apollo's universe was curated BECAUSE these names show PEAD drift, so this validates the implementation not the factor. Eligible for activation in the post-reset window pending: (1) operator approval on allocation %, (2) generalization test on a non-curated universe to confirm edge doesn't depend on the curation.

2026-05-19: forge_xs_momentum -> 0.0 through 5/31 reset (PAPER_CANDIDATE post-reset). Built today as Architect audit #3 (cross-sectional 12-1 momentum, long top-quintile of 15-ETF universe = 10 US sectors + 5 country, monthly rebalance). 9-year backtest 2017-2026: n=79 trades, WR=51.9%, PF=2.05, CAGR +16.22%, max DD 37.35%. All 15 tickers contributed trades. 37% DD is the documented 'momentum crashes' feature at regime turns (Mar-2020, late-2018, 2022 rate shock). Capital ladder -10%/-20% kill rules would pause well before that depth on real money. Activation should be at half-size (0.5×) until 12+ months of clean post-reset trades establish real-money DD profile.

2026-05-20: forge_coint_pairs -> 0.0 (RESEARCH_ONLY birth-state). Architect #5 candidate. 5y backtest with 8 default pairs (KO/PEP, XOM/CVX, HD/LOW, GLD/SLV, EWZ/EWW, TLT/IEF, V/MA, MSFT/GOOGL): n=184 trades, WR=62%, PF=0.91, total -40.9%. Parameter sweep across entry z={2,2.5,3} and stop z={3,4} — NO variant produces positive return. Failures: GLD/SLV decoupled fundamentally (gold inflation-hedge vs silver industrial), XOM/CVX had idiosyncratic 2022-2024 events. Tight-win (3.4%) / wide-loss (-6.2%) profile needs >65% WR to break even; 62% isn't enough. Code retained as template; allocation locked. 2 of 4 architect-recommended new strategies have now failed backtests (vix_carry + coint_pairs); 2 of 4 passed (pead + xs_momentum).

2026-05-23: forge_pead 0.5 -> 0.0 AND forge_nq_overnight 0.5 -> 0.0. Slippage-recalibration sprint (ops/audit/run_slippage_recalibration.py 2026-05-23) confirmed both fail the disciplined gate at realistic execution costs. PEAD at 40bps: IID CI lower 1.025 (17.5% under 1.20 floor; barely above breakeven). NQ overnight at 7bps: IID CI lower 0.526 (negative-EV with 95% confidence). Probation closed early because the disciplined gate has already answered — continuing to deploy capital would burn paper account on known-bad bets. Surviving roster reduces to xs_momentum (1.0×) + gld_pm_long (0.5×) only. Operator can re-activate either if a code change improves the edge (e.g. tighter entry filter, larger universe, lower slippage venue).

2026-05-24: UNIVERSE EXPANSION VARIANTS ACTIVATED (per operator direction: 'main focus is what we have, improve test, fix bugs and get as much data as we can running the remaining strategies against a large pool of items'). 20y disciplined-gate sweep across 8 candidate universes for xs_momentum identified 3 survivors: sectors_spdr_11 (PF 2.50 CI 1.44), style_factors_8 (PF 3.78 CI 1.85, best DD), legacy_sectors_countries_15 (PF 2.22 CI 1.38). Allocation set to 0.5x for paper-evidence accumulation through 6/30. forge_xs_momentum (baseline broad-8) remains at 1.0x. Total xs_momentum-family exposure caps at ~1.6x anchor (1.0 + 3*0.5 with per-strategy cluster cap 0.4x). Full sweep methodology + 20y vs 10y comparison in docs/UNIVERSE_SWEEP_FINDINGS_20260524.md. Real_assets_7 also passed at 10y but failed at 20y (CI 1.19), excluded from deployment.

2026-05-25: Added forge_xs_momentum_legacy15_regime (allocation 0.5x, client_id 126) — same legacy_sectors_countries_15 universe but with SPY>200dma regime gate. Regime-gate sweep at 20y showed gated legacy_15 cuts max DD from 66% to 29% (more than halved) while raising Sharpe from 0.73 to 1.26. Same improvement holds on every other universe but legacy15 is the most dramatic. Shipped as parallel variant to test live whether the gate actually engages in modern regimes (~77% gate-open historically, so ~23% of months we'd be flat).

2026-05-25 (v19): TAIL HEDGE SLEEVE ACTIVATED. forge_tail_hedge at allocation 0.1x (client_id 127). Holds 50/50 GLD+TLT when SPY < 200dma; flat otherwise. Validated by 20y backtest (PF 2.91, n=28, Sharpe 1.91 when engaged, max DD 10.4%, engaged 23% of months). Combined with broad-8 baseline at 10% weight: Sharpe 1.08 -> 1.12, DD 23% -> 21%, CAGR unchanged. First HEDGE-role strategy deployed (per strategy_roles.STRATEGY_ROLES); fills the previously-empty HEDGE slot. Real-money implication: defense move, not offense — adds capital preservation during bear regimes without sacrificing CAGR. Allocation may rise to 0.2x after 30 days of live evidence confirms the regime gate is engaging correctly.

2026-05-25 (v18): WALK-FORWARD OOS REALLOCATION. Tonight's run_walk_forward_oos.py audit split 20y backtest into train (70%) + test (30%) and ranked each universe by whether train survivors STAYED survivors in test: broad_8 STRENGTHENED_OOS (IS Sharpe 1.06 -> OOS 1.22), style_factors_8 STRENGTHENED_OOS (1.18 -> 1.50), sectors_spdr_11 LUCKY_OOS (0.78 -> 1.35 — train fails, test passes = noise), legacy_15 BOTH_FAIL (0.65 -> 1.00, never had real edge in either window). Cut the OOS-weak variants in half: forge_xs_momentum_sectors 0.5 -> 0.25, forge_xs_momentum_legacy15 0.5 -> 0.25, forge_xs_momentum_legacy15_regime 0.5 -> 0.25. Keep them ALIVE (not 0.0) to collect live evidence over the 30-day window — if live PF agrees with the OOS verdict (likely underperformance), the next allocation review at 6/25 considers full kill. broad_8 stays at 1.0x, style + style_top3 stay at 0.5x — they earned their places. Total fleet allocation: 7 strategies summing to 3.25x vs previous 3.5x (saved 0.25x of capacity for re-deployment if a new winner emerges).
